full_page.content:
1924, December
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 19 Cont.
Dec. 16 T.M.J. 3289 Glynn Court for 20 years resisting going to holy Mass or to Church - takes wife to church but refuses to go in himself.
17 Mrs. Rose Kowalski internal cancer fearing for her 8 children if operation for cancer (in womb) be necessary enrolles her- self perpetually to-day.
22 Dying of consumption & pneumonia Rescued in S.M.A. Virginia Kuszak 21 of 4721 Riopell St. Detroit, in dying condition of pneum. & Consumptive cough is enrolled this A.M. at 9,15 by her sister
22 Tubercular Hip. James L. 0'Brien 42 - father of 5 smal children out of work for 4 yrs on account of hip condition is en- rolled for year This p.m.
26th Joseph Clover (36, 3139 Canfield) Away from Confession 6 yrs. - drinking, etc. Enrolled To-day 50g
29 Benedict F. Morvitt, 44 Father of two is gone two weeks from family on Dec. 24; his brothers in anxiety Enrolles him for year - before two days comes home all right weeps & happy Asked what had happened, etc answered "Please don't ask me any questions."
Louis de Simeres, 39 - 2421 Helen, Typhoid - poisoned, given up by doctor and already lamented by friends is enrolled 2nd time in week. Died in peace.
1925
1925, January
Jan. 3 Miss Clar Rolby (35-6, 2140 Springle.) seriously in danger from Gall-stones all examinations demand operation - prepares for worst, by confession and Holy Communion - greatly agitated, is enrolled perpetually to-night. operation arranged for to be next Monday Jan. 5th
afflicted
Jan. 4 George Lehaman 67 Oakfield St. terribly with piles - wishes to die promises to do anything in his power if cured - Enrolled this evening for one year by poor girl convert
Page 20
Jan. 1925 Absence of Live Children Lamented. Mr. & Mrs. A. Novitzky 2682 Ferry - E. married three years heart-broken because of deaths of children before birth are enrolled To-day.
